resendNeutral: If an account exists for that email, another link is on its way.

code.title: Check your inbox
code.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
code.linkDescription: You’re signing in as {{email}}. Confirm to continue.
code.label: Sign-in code
code.noCode: No email? Check your spam folder.
code.resent: New code sent. The previous one no longer works.
code.incompleteLink: This link is incomplete or damaged. Sign in with your email to get a new code.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.description: This is the name your teammates will see.

revoked.title: Your previous password was turned off
revoked.description: Your previous password was disabled because the address hadn’t been confirmed. You can set a new one in your account.

password.hint: Avoid passwords you've used elsewhere. We check against publicly leaked databases — only a short hash prefix is sent, never your full password.

strength.tooShort_one: Too short — {{count}} more character to go
strength.tooShort_other: Too short — {{count}} more characters to go

social.error: Couldn't sign in with that provider. Please try again.
social.notLinked: An account already exists for this address, but it isn’t confirmed yet. Continue with your email to confirm it: Google will work after that.
social.cancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. Try again, or continue with your email.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Continue with your email. New here? The same steps create your account.
signIn.descriptionInvite: Sign in or create your account to accept your invitation.
signIn.verificationResent: Verification email sent — check your inbox.
signIn.verifyPending: Last step: enter the password you chose when signing up to confirm your email. Forgot it? Use "Forgot your password?" below.
signIn.verifyExpired: This verification link has expired (it's valid for 1 hour). Sign in with your password to get a new one.
signIn.verifyOtherAccount: You're signed in as {{email}}. This link confirms a different address: sign out to confirm it.
signIn.descriptionSignup: Just your email: we’ll send you a code. No password to remember.
signIn.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in to continue.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {{email}}, we just sent a link to reset the password. The link expires in 1 hour.

reset.invalidDescription: Reset links expire after one hour and can only be used once. Request a new one to continue.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Pick something you haven't used before. At least 12 characters, and not one that has appeared in a known data breach.
reset.mismatch: Passwords do not match — they are case-sensitive, check capitalization.
reset.success: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.

acceptInvite.signInDescription: Continue as {{email}} to accept. New here? We’ll create your account.

notFound.title: Invitation not found
notFound.message: The link you used is invalid or has been revoked.

expired.title: Invitation expired
expired.message: Ask the person who invited you to send a fresh link.

alreadyAccepted.title: Already accepted
alreadyAccepted.message: This invitation has already been used.

errors.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address
